## 题目内容

37. What can we learn from Alice Moore’s story?
A. Fame is a great thirst of the young.
B. A youth is to be regarded with respect.
C. Positive thinking and action result in success.
D. Success means getting personal desires satisfied.

## 选项

A. A. Fame is a great thirst of the young.

B. B. A youth is to be regarded with respect.

C. C. Positive thinking and action result in success.

D. D. Success means getting personal desires satisfied.

---

## 参考答案

C
